column1: # The closed list, and the keyword lists, for the offline voice pipeline.
# stage | intent | slot | lang | phrase        (tab-separated; '-' for no slot)
#   wake            ways the wake phrase comes out of the recogniser; stripped from the front
#   deterministic   the whole utterance must be (nearly) this phrase; answered from a template
#   grammar         the whole utterance must be (nearly) this phrase; a fixed command
#   ask, brain      keywords: the utterance only has to contain the phrase
# `lang` picks the reply language: en, ur, or mixed (Urdu grammar with English words, answered in
# Urdu). Urdu is written in Urdu script because that is what the recogniser emits for Urdu speech;
# the Roman-Urdu rows cover the times it decides the speech was English.
# Spelling variants (ي/ی, ك/ک, ؤ/و ...) are folded by the matcher and need no rows of their own.
